\footnotesize Figure from [van Heijningen et al., 2023](https://pubs.aip.org/aip/jap/article/133/24/244501/2899601/The-payload-of-the-Lunar-Gravitational-wave).

# Gravitational wave response

How does this readout noise translate to noise on our measurement of gravitational waves?

We assume that the response function from the gravitational polarizations $h_{ij}(t)$ to the
displacement at the sensor $s(t)$ is _linear_: in the frequency domain,

$$ s(f) = L(f) D_{ij} h_{ij}(f)
$$

- $L(f)$ is the __response function__: with the dimensions of a length, is the displacement amplitude corresponding 
to a monochromatic unit strain;
- $D_{ij} = n_i b_j$ is a __pattern function__, where $b_j$ is a tangent unit vector to the surface while $n_i$ is normal to it.

# Structure of LGWA

LGWA is planned to have:

- 4 __stations__, to reduce overall noise and perform active cancellation;
- for each station, two orthogonal __horizontal measurement channels__.

# Strain noise

If we have:

- an estimate for the PSD of the detector __displacement noise__, $S_\text{disp}(f)$,
- an estimate of the lunar __response__ $L(f)$,
- the number of stations $N$,

we can compute the strain noise as 

$$ S_{\text{strain}} (f) = \frac{S _{\text{disp}}(f)}{N L^2(f)}
$$

![](figures/Multiband_concept.pdf){height=75% fig-align="center"}

# The reference frame problem

The frequency-domain waveform at the detector has a travel time factor from the center of the reference frame:

$$ h(f) \propto \exp( i \vec{k} \cdot (\vec{r} - \vec{r}_0))
$$

The center $\vec{r}_0$ should be rigidly connected with the SSB, but it can be elsewhere!

# Parameter estimation: setup

- Parameters: same as GW170817
- zero-noise
- observation time: 
    - 10 years, up to ~3hr before merger
    - 9.6 years, up to ~4.5 months before merger
- accelerated nested sampling with Ultranest

# Sky localization

```{python}
ra_lims = (3.443, 3.4505)
dec_lims = (-0.4109, -0.4049)
# fig=plt.figure(figsize=(5.2, 5.5))

plot_contours(post_ew['ra'], post_ew['dec'], ax=plt.gca(), levels=[.9], cmap=cmap_ew)
plot_contours(post_full['ra'], post_full['dec'], ax=plt.gca(), levels=[.9], cmap=cmap_full)
plt.scatter(params['ra'], params['dec'], marker='x', c='black')

make_arcmin_grid(plt.gca(), ra_lims, dec_lims)
plt.grid(which='minor', lw=.5)
plt.grid(which='major', lw=1)
plt.gca().set_aspect('equal')
plt.xlabel('Right ascension')
plt.ylabel('Declination')
make_legend()
_ = plt.title(r'90\% localization contours')

```
